review_method: Line and control-flow inspection of the changed cache and its actual consumers, plus inspection of the exact focused negative-test bodies and retained execution receipts. No additional application test or network execution.

observations.own_actual_code_observation_required: Digest reuse requires exact canonical eth_getCode transport/target/block identity and equality with its retained raw reply.
observations.expected_pin_is_not_cached: Memo contains only a digest of actual code; Projection._code and keeper.observe each still compare their own reviewed pin.
observations.both_consumers_negative_tests: Actual Projection._code rejects a wrong pin after a memo hit; actual keeper.observe rejects its own wrong code_hashes with both the supplied digest callback and the unchanged default-None path.
observations.aliasing_and_integrity: RPC cache keys begin with a transport integer; code-content memo keys use a distinct string domain. Own raw observations remain necessary across address/block/transport aliases. A mismatched retained raw value raises ProjectionError.
observations.bounded_retention: Encoded code-content key plus digest is charged to the unchanged65536-byte entry and8388608-byte total accounting. No new persistent/global cache or keccak algorithm/dependency.
observations.safe_fallback: Inactive/disabled/unretained/noncanonical/overbound paths compute without retaining a digest. Default keeper hashing and omitted/zero website policy remain separate.
observations.expiry_and_cleanup: Cache hits and new computations check the active budget. Existing scope cleanup clears digest metadata together with raw replies and resets retained bytes and context.
observations.meaningful_verification_scope: Two new focused methods cover own-pin failures, exact-raw conflict, aliases, no-own-raw fallback, unchanged entry/total limits, expiry and cleanup. Only the affected composed exact-economic/NFT parity method was rerun; three previous scope hook bodies were reused without execution.

conclusion: No material source-level pin, budget or cross-request bypass identified in this limited reviewed delta. This is not a universal security or production-readiness guarantee.
